description: Onboard one domain under this API key: creates the site row on the key's plan (the free plan allows one own site) and returns the ownership verification material (DNS TXT name, well-known file URL or homepage meta tag). auditUrls are the pages the first audit will check. Duplicate domains and plan limits fail with the same messages as POST /v1/ai/sites. Requires the sites:write scope. Writes need confirm:true plus a unique idempotencyKey; without confirm:true it returns a dry-run preview and creates nothing. Reusing the same idempotencyKey within 24h returns the first result.

auditUrls.description: http(s) pages the first audit should check

domain.description: Bare domain without protocol or path (example.com)

name: add_site
title: Add a site under this API key
